newsitem.title: USA: US W.Coast prods little changed amid subdued trade.
newsitem.headline: US W.Coast prods little changed amid subdued trade.

text.p: Wholesale prices for U.S. West Coast refined products were little changed Wednesday, as traders avoided the market amid concerns about the volatile futures market.
Crude oil for July delivery on the NYMEX moved ended 14 cents a barrel lower at $18.53 Wednesday, after trading as high as $19.20 a barrel during the day.
"Traders were scared off by NYMEX volatility," one broker said. "It ran up and then collapsed again."

June supplies of Los Angeles cleaner-burning CARB gasoline were bid and offered 0.50 cents lower Wednesday at 55/56 cents, while conventional gasoline and reformulated sold at about one cent lower, dealers said.
